faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Khammam District Court Special Judicial Magistrate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Khammam District Court Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class posts is 21 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 50,000 per month, which includes a conveyance allowance of Rs. 5,000.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class at Sathupalli, Khammam District.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class post?
faq.answer: Eligibility criteria include retired judicial officers, retired judicial ministerial service personnel not below Superintendent, retired High Court officers, non-practicing advocates with 5 years of experience, and retired Gazetted officers with a law degree and magisterial powers experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive, as stated in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two stages: Application Scrutiny and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the scrutiny of their applications and then called for document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class post is contract-based.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It is crucial to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive by Khammam District Court is Dis No. 3663.
